title: Reconstruction of Gettysburg, July 1863, base map tiles
label: RECONSTRUCTION. No aerial photograph of 1863 exists. This is a modern public-domain aerial photograph (USDA NAIP, 2013-06-04, 1 m) with post-1863 features removed and 1863 features added from period maps and records. It is not an exact replica and no accuracy of 100 percent is claimed: every changed region and every added feature is listed in the provenance layer (docs/basemap1863/PROVENANCE-LAYER) with its sources, method, positional error and confidence. What is unknown is left as photographed or neutral.
attribution: Reconstruction of Gettysburg, July 1863, built from USGS/USDA NAIP imagery (2013-06-04, public domain, "NAIP imagery provided by USDA Farm Service Agency") and USGS 3DEP lidar, with period maps from the Library of Congress (G. K. Warren 1868-69, J. B. Bachelder 1876, Hopkins/Converse 1858), National Park Service documents, US Census TIGER, USGS NHD, OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) and Adams County GIS (2023) used for the lists of modern features to remove.
scheme_note: Mapbox GL convention: the world is 512 px at zoom 0, tile (z,x,y) is the standard slippy-map index, tileSize 512. For a 256 px consumer use zoom z+1 with the 4 child indices.
native_note: The source photograph is 1.0 m per pixel; z16 (0.92 m) is native. z17 tiles exist only around ten hotspots and are enlargements (no new detail). No z18 tiles are shipped (it would be a 4x enlargement).

coverage.z17: within 650 m of Peach Orchard, Wheatfield, Little Round Top, The Angle, town centre, Devil's Den, Culp's Hill, Cemetery Hill, Seminary Ridge, Big Round Top

provenance_tiles: docs/basemap1863/PROVENANCE-LAYER/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png (palette PNG, class codes of PROVENANCE-LAYER/classes.json), z13 and finer
